a581fbc0-fd36-5a3b-a95c-a5fe4e140ba1.content: The user used an accessible entrance at a clinic in December 2024.

76e88632-6e96-574a-9b37-fa757b217ccd.content: On a day snow had accumulated and blocked the main-entrance ramp, the user went to a side entrance.

913fe5ad-58b4-592d-b7c6-388bf1ad3a63.content: The user learned on site that the elevator was under inspection and delayed the appointment.

9e933dc4-b03a-5c8f-89ee-f3bb0e36d9ea.content: The day before the next visit, the user called to check whether the elevator would be operating.

345660cc-5ae2-5de8-b5dc-b5092bfbf744.content: The user waited for their turn in front of a ticket machine near the waiting chairs.

cc194702-a2e0-5778-8fcc-9fdfcf0f7fb3.content: On a day the user waited in a corridor without chairs, they leaned against the wall and changed position several times.

02a1c4f6-64a9-520f-b6a3-3bc165688d52.content: On a day their older sister accompanied them, the user found a place to sit immediately after reception.

806250a6-7962-5cdb-8e58-1dd83ca9c45f.content: Reception staff expect that a first-time visitor may ask where the accessible entrance is.

bcb6a50d-f968-565a-be5a-8663179b0e53.content: The local agent cannot infer the user's condition from a record of using an accessible route alone.

09d4cc12-b7a5-5edc-a8f9-6e673b477504.content: Snow accumulation and snow-removal work can temporarily block an entrance route used under ordinary conditions.
